accountingDescription: Run calculations on stock, sold, reserved, and damaged units, and keep a history of every result.

calculationsDescription: Run calculations on stock, sold, reserved, and damaged units to analyze inventory performance and value.
calculationsHint: Run calculations to analyze inventory performance. Results include sell-through rates, stock value, and damage rates. View history to track changes over time.
sellReserveDescription: Record sales to customers or reserve stock for future sales. Creates sales invoices automatically.
sellReserveHint: Use 'Record Sale' to sell items immediately (creates invoice). Use 'Reserve Stock' to hold items for a customer (no invoice yet). Reserved items can be fulfilled later or cancelled.
purchaseInvoicesDescription: Create and manage invoices from suppliers when you purchase items for the warehouse.
purchaseInvoicesHint: Use this tab when you receive items from suppliers. Record the invoice number, supplier name, and item details. Use 'Scan Invoice' to automatically extract data from invoice images.
salesInvoicesDescription: View and manage invoices created when you sell items to customers.
salesInvoicesHint: Use this tab to create manual sales invoices or view automatic invoices from the Sell/Reserve tab. Invoice numbers are auto-generated if not provided.
expensesDescription: Track and manage business expenses such as utilities, rent, and operational costs.
expensesHint: Track all business expenses here. Categorize expenses (rent, utilities, etc.) and record payment methods. Use filters to view expenses by date or category.
sellReserveHint: Recording a sale creates a sales invoice and reduces stock. Reserving holds stock for a customer without invoicing yet.
